visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person dressed in a bright yellow Qing Dynasty imperial robe and hat stands in a room with dark wooden doors. They hold a white plate with an omelet and begin eating with a spoon, exhibiting a neutral expression. (2) The scene cuts to the same person falling dramatically onto a light-colored tiled floor, clutching their throat with their mouth wide open in a scream-like expression. They roll on the floor next to an orange bean bag and a white office chair. (3) A new character appears, played by the same person, wearing a pink and red floral Manchu woman's robe and a large decorative headpiece. They hold a long white object and look around suspiciously in an office-like setting with cameras and lights visible in the background. (4) The person in the imperial robe lies on the floor, gesturing wildly with their hands while a plate of omelet with red ketchup sits nearby. A ring light and tripod are partially visible in the deep background of the office space. (5) The character in the pink robe holds up a silver-colored needle-like object and points it toward the camera, then toward the person on the floor. (6) A close-up shot shows a hand pouring thick red ketchup from a glass bottle labeled 'Kagome' onto a white spoon held near the person lying on the floor. (7) The creator, back in the yellow imperial costume, stands and holds a large golden gong, striking it with a mallet. They then hold the Kagome ketchup bottle toward the camera with a thumbs-up gesture. (8) Graphic overlays of a gold tomato and a Nintendo Switch box appear on screen while the creator performs various dramatic poses and flips in the office environment. (9) The video ends with the creator sitting on the floor in the yellow costume, holding the product and giving a final enthusiastic thumbs-up.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous Qing Dynasty palace drama parody to capture attention before transitioning into a high-energy promotional advertisement for Kagome Ketchup. It highlights the product's natural ingredients and absence of additives while promoting a 'Lucky Draw' lottery event to encourage consumer engagement.
